title: 相位羽流 / Phase Plumes
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party Studio-authored graph and original demo music; existing attributed renderer adapters; outbound license pending

descriptions.zh-CN: 同一 GPU 粒子流形成青蓝、紫红与金色三支羽流。低频推动空间缩放与流场，高频驱动点尺寸；二级属性映射与独立分支可逐节点检查，外环显示完整频谱。
descriptions.en-US: One GPU particle source feeds cyan, magenta and gold plumes. Bass changes spatial scale and flow while treble drives point size. Inspect the two-stage mapping and independent branch inline, with a full-spectrum outer ring.
